source_locator.edition_or_translation: J. M. Ashmand translation from Proclus's Greek paraphrase; 1900 W. Foulsham & Co. new edition
source_locator.short_quote: if it be situated in the mid-heaven, or succedent to the mid-heaven, it is especially strong

calculation_dependencies: angular position relative to the mid-heaven
normalized_rule: Classify a planet's influence as especially strong when it is at the mid-heaven or succedent to the mid-heaven.
synthesis_notes: This is a source-specific traditional influence classification, not a modern physics or house-rulership claim.
review_notes: Keep this mid-heaven condition separate from the horizon and below-horizon conditions in the same chapter.
transmission_notes: The condition is stated in the Ashmand/Proclus main text; no later house-rulership or accidental-dignity system is imported.
